weekly-recap.scene: A person kneeling and arranging seven loose paper sheets in a broad fan, glancing back over the week; a coral ribbon connects the sheets. Warm ochre-red #8f4335 and coral #db7b61.

weekly-pattern.scene: A crouching investigator looks through a large magnifying glass at a loop of tiny footprints and repeating habit marks. Warm ochre-red #8f4335 and coral #db7b61.

weekly-next.scene: A standing person stacks three planning cards onto a small next-week desk calendar. Warm ochre-red #8f4335 and coral #db7b61.

monthly-result.scene: A seated person opens a broad monthly calendar booklet and compares differently sized planned and achieved paper tabs. Deep amber #875b21 and gold #d79a34.

monthly-bottleneck.scene: A person carefully unties a sculptural knot made of amber and cream paper ribbons, freeing one end. Deep amber #875b21 and gold #d79a34.

monthly-experiment.scene: A person in an apron arranges small laboratory beakers beside a folded plan sheet on a low table. Deep amber #875b21 and gold #d79a34.

quarterly-evidence.scene: A traveler stands beside three differently shaped route markers, holding a small map and looking back at a winding path. Deep blue #345585 and cornflower #5c82c5.

quarterly-direction.scene: A person braces a large freestanding compass and rotates its blue needle toward a new direction. Deep blue #345585 and cornflower #5c82c5.

quarterly-next.scene: A person leans over a route map and plants three blue goal markers on the next winding path. Deep blue #345585 and cornflower #5c82c5.

yearly-coordinate.scene: A person unrolls a tall scroll; four different seasonal symbols suggest a year-long journey. Deep violet #624782 and lavender #9a73bd.

yearly-release.scene: A seated person sets old loose pages to one side while holding one carefully selected keepsake handbook. Deep violet #624782 and lavender #9a73bd.

yearly-next.scene: A person opens the first blank leaf of a new bound book beside a large tree-ring clock. Deep violet #624782 and lavender #9a73bd.

decision-question.scene: A person at the fork of two paper paths holds a folded question sheet and studies the choice. Olive #455f34 and leaf #759d58.

decision-evidence.scene: A person leans across a balancing scale, placing fact sheets on one side and mystery tokens on the other. Olive #455f34 and leaf #759d58.

decision-choice.scene: A person reaches to place one option tile into an open olive-green decision box. Olive #455f34 and leaf #759d58.

decision-review.scene: A person pins a bookmark to a future page on a freestanding paper calendar while looking back at a completed choice. Olive #455f34 and leaf #759d58.
